title: Tim Cook steps down as Apple CEO: Who is John Ternus and what changes are coming?
snippet: Apple CEO Tim Cook steps down on 1 September, with John Ternus taking over as CEO. Here's who John Ternus is, why Apple chose him, what Tim Cook will do as executive chairman and how the leadership change could affect Apple's products and strategy.

title: Foldable iPhone may get Apple Pencil support; stylus launch could be delayed
snippet: Apple has reportedly tested a smaller Apple Pencil prototype for its upcoming foldable iPhone, but the stylus is unlikely to debut with the device. The side-mounted accessory may pose usability issues and risk damaging the foldable display.

title: Nearly 32% of organizations decide to build in-house software using AI coding agents over purchases: McKinsey
snippet: Organizations are increasingly using agentic coding tools to build software in-house in lieu of purchasing it, according to a McKinsey report titled, "The state of AI in 2026."

title: Trust levels for generative AI drops below 40%, yet consumers rely on AI product advice: McKinsey
snippet: Consumers do not trust artificial intelligence (AI) advice, as the trust level for generative AI drops below 40 per cent but they turn to it anyway, according to research discussed on The McKinsey Podcast.

title: How China’s AI policies avoid painful past tech crackdowns
